A1.reason: Shows the rows added and updated per table, the columns touched, and any table, column or row count outside what the agreement names, which bears on C1, C2 and C4 before anything is promoted.

A2.reason: The A1 rehearsal is good for one hour at most, and the promotion is followed by tidying and presenting, so a fresh rehearsal at A2 is needed to show that the promotion can still be reversed when the release is asked for (C7).

C1.for_what_part: The staged changes match the approved list and touch only the named tables and rows, as staged at A1. No answer reads the live tables after promotion; the link from staged to live is the promotion's line in the record.

C2.for_what_part: The 100 cases and the 100 account status values are shown as counts and membership in the staged set at A1. The live tables are not read. The category value is not checked here (see C3).

C4.for_what_part: Tables and columns touched, and row counts, are shown for the staged changes at A1. The live tables after promotion are not read.

C8.for_what_part: At A2 the release check shows that the release covers exactly the promoted customers, in the approved wording. Whether the notices were ordered that way is shown only at A3, by the sending calls on the record.

C9.for_what_part: Confirmed sending calls are matched to the release by recipient and wording fingerprints, and calls ordered but not confirmed are listed. Duplicate calls per customer are visible on the record. Whether each call is one the release allows is shown only as far as those fingerprints match.

parsed.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Three things the task requires are not shown by any plan instrument. (a) C10, the outbox rows: 'trace of a call' is in no plan and costs 10 per named line, so the 50 allowance covers at most five of the 100 sends; sent as released shows only the record's confirmed calls, not the outbox. (b) C5, that the worker read only approved accounts: 'scope of a call' is likewise named-lines only, and the allowance covers at most five of the 101 reads. (c) C3, the category rule: no instrument checks category values, since the agreement fixes none. I would have wanted a whole-set outbox check and a whole-set read-scope check at A3 and A1. The library did not give them, and the price rules out sampling them all. I have not added any named-line instrument now, because the plan cannot hold one. Some sampling may be asked for during the work from the allowance, if a wake shows that it is needed. Also, no answer reads the live tables after promotion, except the undo rehearsal, which runs on a copy.
